headline: Diversification & Expansion to Fuel Growth

highlights: Revenue came in at INR 10.65 Bn, up 15% QoQ and up 18% YoY, beating our estimates by 7%.
Gross margin stood at 53.1%, compared with 57.3% in the previous quarter and 59.88% in the corresponding quarter last year, versus our estimate of 56.0%.
EBITDA came in at INR 1,099.8 Mn, up 17.3% QoQ but down 9.5% YoY, surpassing our estimate by 7.8%.
EBITDA margin stood at 10.3%, compared with 10.1% QoQ and 13.5% YoY, versus our estimate of 10.25%.
valuation: We maintain our BUY rating and revise our target price to INR 1,795.
We have Buy rating on the stock with target price of INR 1,795.
watch: Outlook: GMM Pfaudler’s record order book and its move into peptides, defence, nuclear and semiconductors give it strong revenue visibility and a reliable source of long-term growth.
